about.title: Your Trusted Industrial Distribution Partner
about.subtitle: PT. Anugerah Panca Wisesa (APW) is an industrial distribution company specializing in welding consumables, modern inverter welding machines, wear plates, and industrial valves from globally trusted brands.
about.description: With a commitment to excellence and international quality standards, APW serves various industries including mining, oil & gas, construction, manufacturing, and power generation.

vision.title: Vision
vision.description: To become a trusted industrial product distributor providing superior and sustainable solutions for all manufacturing & energy sectors in Indonesia.

mission.title: Mission
mission.items: We are committed to providing international quality products at competitive prices, offering technical consultation services for every client's needs, maintaining supply chain continuity with stock availability and fast distribution, and building trust as a long-term partner for heavy industries.

expertise.description: Deep knowledge of industrial products and applications to provide the best solutions.

products.title: Our Main Products
products.subtitle: PT. Anugerah Panca Wisesa (APW) offers superior product lines that are primary solutions for welding, cutting, wear protection, and industrial valve systems.
products.description: We distribute four premier product lines that form the foundation of APW's distribution excellence: STARLET Welding Consumables, StarArc Welding Machines, AlloyStar Wear Plate, and TSV Industrial Valves.

starlet.name: STARLET® Welding Consumables
starlet.description: High-quality consumables for various welding processes including SMAW, GMAW/MAG, FCAW, and GTAW/TIG
features: Easy slag removal, neat weld results
Optimal deposition rate with high efficiency

stararc.name: StarArc® Welding Machines
stararc.description: Modern inverter welding machines with precise current & voltage control, supporting various processes
features: High duty cycle, stable for heavy operations
Modern digital panel with precise settings

allostar.name: AlloyStar® Wear Plate
allostar.description: Wear plate with hardfacing and cladding layers providing maximum protection against wear, friction, and corrosion
features: Easy to apply on buckets, chutes, crushers, conveyors

tsv.name: TSV® Industrial Valves
tsv.description: High-quality industrial valves for regulating fluid flow in various applications
features: Assembly process according to API, ASME, ANSI standards
